scope: Ordinary immutable Binary/BinRef/ErlSubBits layouts, construction, sharing, copying-GC offheap sweep and destruction. Not whole-file admission or writable/magic/NIF/distribution binary support.
adaptations: Fallible explicit-domain allocation; an aligned owner prefix precedes the native-shaped binary header and immutable payload.
Real C11 atomic word reference count replaces ethread's reference-count primitive; domain/heap/control APIs remain serialized.
Only ordinary immutable binaries enter the offheap chain. Actual BinRef/SubBits layouts and the 64-byte heap threshold are preserved.
Loader and process destruction release offheap references before freeing heap/arena storage; copying-GC updates moved references and releases dead ones.
Flat metadata copies acquire their own binary references and roll back on reference-count exhaustion; raw literals retain code ownership.
Execution witnesses are ordinary compiler-produced binary literal/identity/tuple/module_info functions, not a new executor or bytecode.
